content: 1. For individuals over 12 years of age, administer 15-30 mL of the product orally every 15 minutes until vomiting ceases. Do not exceed 5 doses per hour. 2. For children aged 2-12 years, administer 5-10 mL of the product orally every 15 minutes until vomiting ceases. Do not exceed 5 doses per hour. 3. The safety and efficacy of this product have not been established for children under 2 years of age. 4. Common side effects may include abdominal pain and diarrhea. 5. This product is contraindicated in individuals with hypersensitivity to the drug or its excipients, as well as those with hereditary fructose intolerance. 6. Patients with diabetes should consult a healthcare provider before self-medicating with this product. 7. If symptoms recur, worsen, or persist, notify a healthcare provider promptly. 8. If more than 5 doses are taken within one hour, seek medical advice from a healthcare provider immediately. 9. Avoid ingesting fluids for at least 15 minutes after taking this product. 10. There are no studies available regarding the use of this product during lactation. 11. Pregnancy Category: Not applicable. However, in general, products classified as Category A are considered safe, as controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk. 12. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for similar concerns. 13. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. For less severe cases, contact a poison control center. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. 14. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. 15. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. 16. This information was last revised in May 2024. 17. This document provides a summary and does not include all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for every individual. 18. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
